en.sayed-ali-raza: By Allāh, how bad are you for igniting flames of war.
You are intrigued against but do not intrigue (against the enemy). Your boundaries are decreasing but you do not get enraged over it.
Those against you do not sleep but you are unmindful. By Allāh, those who leave matters one for the other are subdued.
By Allāh, I believed about you that if battle rages and death hovers around you, you will cut away from son of Abī Ṭālib like the severing of head from the trunk. [2]
